title: Isolate records
purpose: Enter, validate and review antimicrobial susceptibility records with master-driven panels and duplicate safeguards.
noLabMessage: Records are strictly laboratory-scoped. Open Laboratories and choose the active site.
noLabHelp: Select a laboratory to begin. No records are merged across laboratory codes.
capRecords: Isolate records reached the 100,000-row safety cap; narrow the cohort or export directly for a complete listing.
capMaster: {{label}} reached the 10,000-entry selector cap; refine or deactivate unused master entries.
emptyFiltered: Adjust the search or status filter.
emptyNone: Create a record manually or import a validated laboratory batch.

editor.duplicateBody: A matching record already exists for this patient/specimen identity (record #{{id}}). Review it before finalising.
editor.ageFromBirthDate: {{count}} years old at the specimen date.
editor.ageConflictTitle: Age and date of birth disagree
editor.ageConflictBody: The recorded age is {{entered}}, but the date of birth gives {{derived}} at the specimen date. Correct whichever is wrong before finalising.
editor.admissionAfterSpecimen: Admission cannot be after the specimen was collected.
editor.diagnosisHint: Search by code or by wording. Several diagnoses can be recorded; each keeps its code system.
editor.diagnosisEmptyHint: No diagnosis catalogue is configured. Add entries to the “diagnosis” code set in Master Studio → Coded values, or load your national value set.
editor.diagnosisPlaceholder: Search diagnoses by code or wording…
editor.uncodedDiagnosisHint: Only for a diagnosis with no code in the catalogue. Coded diagnoses are what analyses group by.
editor.noAntibioticsBody: Select organism and specimen to match a panel, or add antibiotics manually.
editor.interpretationSafetyBody: Entered S/I/R values are stored with their method and guideline provenance. Configure validated breakpoints in Breakpoint Centre; the user remains responsible for result authorisation.
editor.noMarkersBody: Prescribe markers on the AST panel, or add them here for this isolate.
editor.genotypeBody: A detected determinant predicts resistance but does not confirm it. Report alongside the phenotypic result and the laboratory's validated interpretation policy.

notify.savedDetail: Record #{{id}} saved as {{status}}; review the canonical result and decision support below.
notify.confirmDelete: Delete isolate record #{{id}}? This action is audited.

help.drafts: Draft records preserve incomplete laboratory work. Final records have passed the application’s minimum field checks; this does not replace laboratory authorisation.
help.duplicateBody: The application checks the configured specimen/patient identity before finalisation and warns instead of silently overwriting.
help.provenanceBody: Each result stores measurement, S/I/R interpretation, method and guideline. Breakpoint definitions remain configurable in the Breakpoint Centre.

omics.saveFirstBody: Omics files and accessions attach to a stored isolate. Save this record as a draft, then return here to add sequencing data.
omics.empty: No omics data recorded for this isolate.
omics.copiedTitle: File copied into the AMRIT workspace
omics.linkedNote: Large files stay where they are; AMRIT records the path and digest so the artefact remains traceable.
omics.attachFirst: Attach a file and add a record
